request.deadline: Action can only be enacted at Epoch 653; new terms expire at Epoch 799
deliverables: Remove expiring or retired committee credentials listed in the action
Seat four incoming committee members with expiration epoch 799
Leave Eastern Cardano Council, Tingvard, and Ace Alliance unchanged
request.recipient: Marek Mahut, Phil_uplc / Philip DiSarro, Leandros BSP, and Cardano Curia as incoming committee members
request.what: Update Constitutional Committee 2026 by replacing expiring Constitutional Committee seats with elected candidates

claims.claim: The action updates four Constitutional Committee seats whose terms expire at the end of Epoch 653 by appointing candidates elected through the 2026 Constitutional Committee election.
The successful candidates will serve terms ending at Epoch 799, with each listed incoming member assigned a 146-epoch term.
The document states that the committee quorum remains unchanged at 2/3.
The election process included candidate registration, a public voting period, an independent audit of results, and publication of the audited outcome before submission.
The four candidates receiving the most voting power were Philip DiSarro, Leandros BSP, Marek Mahut, and Cardano Curia.
The document provides IPFS references for audited election results and audited files, plus an Ekklesia ballot URL.
The results of the DRep vote were independently audited by DQuadrant.
The action changes only the four expiring seats and leaves Eastern Cardano Council, Tingvard, and Ace Alliance unchanged until epoch 726.
The document explains that ledger term-limit rules make enactment valid only in Epoch 653 because earlier enactment would exceed committeeMaxTermLength.
The document does not provide candidate track records, independence disclosures, or conflict-of-interest disclosures for the incoming committee members.

summary: The proposal documents the requested committee update, election results, on-chain credentials, term timing, quorum continuity, and audit references, but it lacks candidate track-record and independence/conflict disclosures required by the committee update doctrine.
